paragraphs.text: Tatyova is a merfolk druid native to the plane of Dominaria .

Hailing from the Voda Sea , Tatyova left her aquatic homeland to pursue druidic studies in the forested realm of Yavimaya . This experience deepened her connection to the natural world, especially the magic inherent in forests.

Trained in the druidic arts and skilled in harmonizing with both the rhythms of the tides and the coastal woodlands of Dominaria, Tatyova returned to her people in the underwater domain of Vodalia after completing her apprenticeship with the elves of Yavimaya. She has played a vital role in moderating Emperor Mihail II ’s more aggressive tendencies, advocating for a merfolk society devoted to the protection and stewardship of the natural environment.
